title: Data Centers Are Driving an Alarming Gas Power Expansion in the US
summary: Global Energy Monitor also tracks energy projects in countries around the world, including China, the world’s largest importer of natural gas. Many data centers being built in China are being sited in rural areas that have an excess of renewable energy production.
